{"script":"set -e
mkdir -p temp_workspace
# 2. Inventory
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace/listings.txt || true
# 3. Extract paths whose final component is exactly "workspace"
:> temp_workspace/candidates.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ "$(basename "$p")" = "workspace" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace/candidates.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace/listings.txt
# 4. Retrieve metadata (including type)
:> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    stat -c '%n|%F|%s|%U|%G|%a|%Y' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s|stat_error\n' "$p"
  else
    printf '%s|missing\n' "$p"
  fi
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt > temp_workspace/metadata.txt
# 5. Filter regular files
awk -F'|' '$2=="regular file"{print $1}' temp_workspace/metadata.txt > temp_workspace/regular_candidates.txt
# 6. Confirm within /working, dedupe
if [ -f temp_workspace/regular_candidates.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -z "$p" ] && continue
    real=$(realpath -m -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$real" in
      /working* ) printf '%s\n' "$real" ;;
    esac
done < temp_workspace/regular_candidates.txt | sort -u > temp_workspace/unique_regular.txt
else
  : > temp_workspace/unique_regular.txt
fi
# 7. Append timestamped audit summary and verify intermediate files readable
count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/unique_regular.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
echo "$ts count:$count" >> temp_workspace/audit.txt
for f in listings.txt candidates.txt metadata.txt regular_candidates.txt unique_regular.txt audit.txt; do
  if [ ! -r temp_workspace/"$f" ]; then
    echo "$f not readable" >> temp_workspace/audit.txt
  fi
done
# 8. Create readiness marker
echo "ready" > temp_workspace/ready_for_decision
# Final: output yes/no depending on existence of a regular file named "workspace" under /working
ans="no"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ "$(basename "$p")" = "workspace" ]; then
    ans="yes"; break
  fi
done < temp_workspace/unique_regular.txt
echo "$ans"
"}
